simple.meaning: a summit (of a tree or mountain)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָמִיר (H534) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָמִיר (ʼâmîyr) means a summit (of a tree or mountain) First listed occurrence: Isa 17 6.

definitions.short: a summit (of a tree or mountain)
definitions.full: H534. amir אָמִיר noun masculine top, summit, of tree Isa 17:6 ; of mountain 17:9 (? So Ew Kn De Di; Lag Che Brd Or following ᵐ5 & read הָאֱמֹרִי ); plural construct אֲמִרֵי Gen 49:21 (so read for אִמְרֵי , Ew Di and others, compare also 1. אֵלָה p.18).
definitions.rootNote: apparently from 559 (in the sense of self-exaltation );
